scope_definition.scope_note: Exact flagship journals plus an explicit, curated related-journal target set. Related sets are not claimed to exhaust either publisher's portfolio; no biology-only or research-article-only filter has yet been applied.

definitions.pmc_public_records: PMC search matches excluding embargoed records; includes author manuscripts and multiple article types.
definitions.xml_text_mining_candidates: Public PMC matches in the OA subset or Author Manuscript Dataset, eligible for the official XML/text retrieval route.
definitions.open_access_candidates: Public PMC matches in the Open Access Subset; licenses vary.
definitions.open_access_with_pdf_candidates: OA subset plus the PMC has-PDF filter; candidate count, not an object-verified download count.

limitations: Search matches are not confirmed file downloads. Validate S3 versions and their xml_url/pdf_url/media_urls before ingestion.
Author manuscripts without CC licenses have XML/text but not PDF/media/supplemental objects in the official distribution.
Deduplicate by PMCID/DOI and distinguish accepted manuscripts from final published versions.
Related journal lists are explicit, curated targets rather than an exhaustive publisher catalogue.
No biology-only, original-research-only, retraction or correction exclusions were applied to these availability counts.
